scope: Pinned original 102 only; the two additional known-issue controls are excluded. Eligibility and preparer support do not establish a completed healthy seed, fault campaign, or bug. Historical CrashFuzz results are not Mallory GraphChecker results.

phase_reuse.static_scope: once per immutable compiled case/classpath; regenerate on changed source, protocol overlay, or classpath
phase_reuse.bytecode_weave: once per immutable case campaign; receipt verified on reuse
phase_reuse.healthy_trace: one fault-free original JUnit run per campaign; archived and resumed
phase_reuse.fault_trial_trace: fresh original JUnit JVM and fresh dynamic trace/graph per fault sequence
phase_reuse.current_avoidable_processing: New trial receipts cache exact target-throw counts bound to archived trace SHA; old receipts retain full prior-trace scan. The runner still verifies selected woven class hashes per trial; no benchmark-backed change to that check.
phase_reuse.scratch_location: New configs may set scratch_root to an existing absolute nonsymlink directory; absent key retains /dev/shm default. The trial trace remains fresh per fault sequence.
